Welcome to Kalpanā AI! You can now run 3 Million Tokens directly on any device offline and share full Knowledge Packs (.kp) with your friends.

After hitting 3M tokens, you can continue chatting seamlessly, though Kalpanā may start to gradually fade older context details. Whenever needed, simply export your session as a 6.3 MB .kp Knowledge Pack and start a brand-new 3M token conversation anytime!

VIJÑĀNAAI Privacy Policy

Air-Gapped Local Execution · Zero Cloud Data Transmission

1. Web Application Telemetry

When accessing the public web application at kalpana-vijnana.web.app, basic aggregated counters record web visits and download metrics to display community statistics. No personal identifiers are collected.

2. Air-Gapped On-Device Processing

Once loaded or installed on your device hardware:

  • Zero Server Transmission: 100% of LLM model inference and RIF context searches run locally via browser WebGPU shaders.
  • Complete Data Privacy: Your prompts, attached PDFs, dictation audio, and Knowledge Packs (.kp) never leave your device.
  • Air-Gapped Offline Operation: The application functions 100% offline with zero active internet connection required.

3. Data Ownership & Retention

You retain 100% complete ownership of all generated conversation context and exported Knowledge Packs. No chat logs or user files are ever stored on cloud servers.
